gt-01-c2.text: Weisstein, Eric W. Handshaking Lemma. MathWorld--A Wolfram Web Resource.
gt-01-c2.quote: the sum of the vertex degrees is twice the number of edges
gt-01-c2.claim: Add up the degrees of all the vertices in a graph and you get exactly twice the number of edges.

gt-01-c2.text: Weisstein, Eric W. Handshaking Lemma. MathWorld--A Wolfram Web Resource.
gt-01-c2.quote: the number of odd-degree vertices is even
gt-01-c2.claim: It follows that the number of vertices with odd degree must be even.

gt-01-c3.text: Weisstein, Eric W. Complete Graph. MathWorld--A Wolfram Web Resource.
gt-01-c3.quote: A complete graph is a simple graph in which each pair of distinct vertices is joined by an edge.
gt-01-c3.claim: It's a complete graph, meaning Kₙ connects every pair of vertices; K₄ has 6 edges and K₅ has 10.
